title: Make a game-ready 3D model from one picture
description: Sends a picture of one object (plain background, whole object in frame) to comfy-forge's image-to-3D (Pixal3D on its ComfyUI: a running one, or one started for the job and stopped afterwards), then collapses the sculpt it returns, about 700000 triangles, under the game budget and validates it. variant=pixal3d-multi takes a four-view turnaround sheet for a character. The sculpt stays in the asset as the source mesh; the game-ready GLB is what exports. The sides the picture does not show are guessed, and nobody looks at the result: open it. Needs comfy-forge 0.11.0 or later with its 3D weights installed; about four minutes on a 16 GB GPU.
